verses.text: A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

xrefs.text: In a surge of anger I hid My face from you for a moment, but with everlasting kindness I will have compassion on you,” says the LORD your Redeemer.
And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments, according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
For the choirmaster. Of David. To bring remembrance. Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!

For I am with you to save you, declares the LORD. Though I will completely destroy all the nations to which I have scattered you, I will not completely destroy you. Yet I will discipline you justly, and will by no means leave you unpunished.”

verses.text: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.

xrefs.text: For the arrows of the Almighty have pierced me; my spirit drinks in their poison; the terrors of God are arrayed against me.
For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
Indeed, the LORD’s hand was against them, to eliminate them from the camp, until they had all perished.
He bent His bow and set me as the target for His arrow.
Now the hand of the LORD was heavy on the people of Ashdod and its vicinity, ravaging them and afflicting them with tumors.

verses.text: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.

xrefs.text: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am frail; heal me, O LORD, for my bones are in agony.
Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones You have crushed rejoice.
Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
Why do you want more beatings? Why do you keep rebelling? Your head has a massive wound, and your whole heart is afflicted.
Let us examine and test our ways, and turn back to the LORD.

verses.text: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.

xrefs.text: For evils without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has failed within me.
and said: “O my God, I am ashamed and embarrassed to lift up my face to You, my God, because our iniquities are higher than our heads, and our guilt has reached the heavens.
Come to Me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
My transgressions are bound into a yoke, knit together by His hand; they are draped over my neck, and the Lord has broken my strength. He has delivered me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.
He Himself bore our sins in His body on the tree, so that we might die to sin and live to righteousness. “By His stripes you are healed.”

verses.text: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.

xrefs.text: Why do you want more beatings? Why do you keep rebelling? Your head has a massive wound, and your whole heart is afflicted.
You know my folly, O God, and my guilt is not hidden from You.
Is there no balm in Gilead? Is no physician there? Why then has the health of the daughter of my people not been restored?
For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.
When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.

verses.text: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.

xrefs.text: I go about blackened, but not by the sun. I stand up in the assembly and cry for help.
I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.
I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.
For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.

verses.text: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.

xrefs.text: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.
After all this, the LORD afflicted Jehoram with an incurable disease of the bowels.
Immediately, because Herod did not give glory to God, an angel of the Lord struck him down, and he was eaten by worms and died.
My flesh is clothed with worms and encrusted with dirt; my skin is cracked and festering.
“A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”

verses.text: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.

xrefs.text: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
I sigh when food is put before me, and my groans pour out like water.
I go about blackened, but not by the sun. I stand up in the assembly and cry for help.
We all growl like bears and moan like doves. We hope for justice, but find none, for salvation, but it is far from us.
For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Doe of the Dawn.” A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?

verses.text: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.

xrefs.text: You have heard, O LORD, the desire of the humble; You will strengthen their hearts. You will incline Your ear,
I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
For in this tent we groan, longing to be clothed with our heavenly dwelling,
In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.
“How do You know me? Nathanael asked. Jesus replied, “Before Philip called you, I saw you under the fig tree.

verses.text: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.

xrefs.text: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.
My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.

verses.text: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.

xrefs.text: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.
But all those who knew Jesus, including the women who had followed Him from Galilee, stood at a distance watching these things.
He has removed my brothers from me; my acquaintances have abandoned me.
“Look, an hour is coming and has already come when you will be scattered, each to his own home, and you will leave Me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with Me.
Now by chance a priest was going down the same road, but when he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

verses.text: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.

xrefs.text: Furthermore, Ahithophel said to Absalom, “Let me choose twelve thousand men and set out tonight in pursuit of David.
For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.
For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life— men with no regard for God. Selah
The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.

verses.text: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.

xrefs.text: He was oppressed and afflicted, yet He did not open His mouth. He was led like a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is silent, so He did not open His mouth.
I have become mute; I do not open my mouth because of what You have done.
I was speechless and still; I remained silent, even from speaking good, and my sorrow was stirred.
When they heaped abuse on Him, He did not retaliate; when He suffered, He made no threats, but entrusted Himself to Him who judges justly.
But the king replied, “What have I to do with you, O sons of Zeruiah? If he curses me because the LORD told him, ‘Curse David,’ who can ask, ‘Why did you do this?’”

verses.text: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.

xrefs.text: Therefore, the prudent keep silent in such times, for the days are evil.
They said this to test Him, in order to have a basis for accusing Him. But Jesus bent down and began to write on the ground with His finger.
And the chief priests began to accuse Him of many things.
Do not rely on a friend; do not trust in a companion. Seal the doors of your mouth from her who lies in your arms.

verses.text: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.

xrefs.text: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.
I call on You, O God, for You will answer me. Incline Your ear to me; hear my words.
On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.

verses.text: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me— those who taunt me when my foot slips.”

xrefs.text: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
Vengeance is Mine; I will repay. In due time their foot will slip; for their day of disaster is near, and their doom is coming quickly.”
Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.
Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,

verses.text: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

xrefs.text: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.
I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of sorrows, acquainted with grief. Like one from whom men hide their faces, He was despised, and we esteemed Him not.
In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.

verses.text: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.

xrefs.text: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
He who conceals his sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them will find mercy.
Then he sings before men with these words: ‘I have sinned and perverted what was right; yet I did not get what I deserved.
For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
and not only by his arrival, but also by the comfort he had received from you. He told us about your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced all the more.

verses.text: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.

xrefs.text: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.
If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me first.
You will be hated by everyone because of My name, but the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.
Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those who would destroy me— my enemies for no reason. Though I did not steal, I must repay.
A Psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom. O LORD, how my foes have increased! How many rise up against me!

verses.text: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.

xrefs.text: They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.
Should good be repaid with evil? Yet they have dug a pit for me. Remember how I stood before You to speak good on their behalf, to turn Your wrath from them.
Do not be like Cain, who belonged to the evil one and murdered his brother. And why did Cain slay him? Because his own deeds were evil, while those of his brother were righteous.
But Jesus responded, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone Me?
If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.

verses.text: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.

xrefs.text: But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.
For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.
Be not far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.
They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”
For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Doe of the Dawn.” A Psalm of David. My God, my God, why have You forsaken me? Why are You so far from saving me, so far from my words of groaning?

verses.text: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.

xrefs.text: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.
Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
Be not far from me, O God. Hurry, O my God, to help me.
A Psalm of David. I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
